column2: The spring does not ask who can afford a drink. The filter supplier unfortunately does.
We repaired a cistern without a ceremony. I think the spring will forgive us.
The kitchens fed three streets last night. We will need to refill every shelf.
A pilgrim brought a map with seven wells. We have found two and a very convincing puddle.
The children voted to name our newest pump. It is now called Sir Drips.
We count clean cups as carefully as donations. Both disappear faster than expected.
A quiet room and a warm meal can settle an argument better than a sermon.
Our oldest filter has outlasted three committees. It remains the most reliable member.
The rain collectors are full, but we still test every batch. Faith is no substitute for a clean bottle.
The next neighborhood meal will need more bowls than chairs.
The community kitchen sent this with its thanks.
